subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which linked read-image media fix should maintainers treat as the canonical path for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but there are competing open PRs and the current-file candidate still has PR-level proof and lint concerns, so cleanup should not queue another duplicate repair branch.

options.title: Repair and review the current-file PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the primary candidate after its lint/proof blockers are resolved because it targets the current `embedded-agent-subscribe.*` files.

options.title: Port the older start-args fallback
options.body: Revive the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 approach only if maintainers prefer start-args path recovery over persisting inline image bytes, since that branch targets removed file names.

options.title: Keep Feishu direct-media separate
options.body: Handle direct Feishu `MEDIA:` and streaming-card failures in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94894 instead of expanding this issue beyond the shared read-tool media bridge.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the current-file PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the primary candidate after its lint/proof blockers are resolved because it targets the current `embedded-agent-subscribe.*` files.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points the active current-main files to Vincent Koc, while prior owners are on predecessor paths.
